text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation being here. The environment is modern, intentional, and dedicated to research and development, as the "R+D" wall proclaims. The creative energy is palpable, inviting contemplation about innovation and humanity’s constant drive to understand and improve our coexistence with technology. I am inspired to ponder how spaces such as this shape not just the tangible world, but the very way we think and connect as humans.
